optimized_sql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN cnt1 > 1071 THEN ext_tax_avg1 ELSE net_paid_inc_tax_avg1 END AS bucket1,
    CASE WHEN cnt2 > 39161 THEN ext_tax_avg2 ELSE net_paid_inc_tax_avg2 END AS bucket2,
    CASE WHEN cnt3 > 29434 THEN ext_tax_avg3 ELSE net_paid_inc_tax_avg3 END AS bucket3,
    CASE WHEN cnt4 > 6568 THEN ext_tax_avg4 ELSE net_paid_inc_tax_avg4 END AS bucket4,
    CASE WHEN cnt5 > 21216 THEN ext_tax_avg5 ELSE net_paid_inc_tax_avg5 END AS bucket5
FROM reason
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS cnt1,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS ext_tax_avg1,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20) AS net_paid_inc_tax_avg1,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS cnt2,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS ext_tax_avg2,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40) AS net_paid_inc_tax_avg2,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS cnt3,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS ext_tax_avg3,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60) AS net_paid_inc_tax_avg3,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS cnt4,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS ext_tax_avg4,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80) AS net_paid_inc_tax_avg4,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS cnt5,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS ext_tax_avg5,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) FILTER (WHERE ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100) AS net_paid_inc_tax_avg5
    FROM store_sales
) AS ss_agg ON true
WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
